This is a lesson on one comping rhythm the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Boogaloo stabs**. It is built up from 2 simpler patterns, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read what the band will play on the staff underneath: the whole pass is written out when Play starts, before it sounds. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Comping rhythms](index.qmd#chords)

## The pattern

A stab on beat 1, the chord pushed and held on the and of 2, and sometimes an answering stab late in the bar. Locks with the boogaloo bass riff.

It belongs in *Boogaloo*. Here it is in the boogaloo style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Long notes

Start with something simpler. One held chord per bar (or per chord). Leaves the most room for a soloist.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](chords-pad.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums keep time with you; switch the others on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="boogaloo" data-chart="F7|F7|Bb7|F7" data-tempo="78" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Long notes","opts":{"compRhythm":"pad"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Charleston

A held chord on beat 1 and a short one on the and of 2. The first comping rhythm most players learn.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](chords-charleston.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums keep time with you; switch the others on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="boogaloo" data-chart="F7|F7|Bb7|F7" data-tempo="78" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Charleston","opts":{"compRhythm":"charleston"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Boogaloo stabs, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** A stab on 1, the chord pushed and held on the and of 2, and sometimes an answer late in the bar. It locks with the boogaloo bass riff, which pushes on the same and of 2.

The band plays it on piano here; the step after next has it on guitar.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="boogaloo" data-chart="F7|F7|Bb7|F7" data-tempo="78" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Boogaloo stabs","opts":{"compRhythm":"stabs"}},{"label":"Charleston (the step before)","opts":{"compRhythm":"charleston"}}]'></div>

## Step 4: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 112 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's chord player off and take the part yourself.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="boogaloo" data-chart="F7|F7|Bb7|F7" data-tempo="112" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp bass" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Boogaloo stabs","opts":{"compRhythm":"stabs"}}]'></div>

## Step 5: On the guitar

The same rhythm on the guitar. On guitar each chord is a strum or a pluck of a chord shape; a short chord is choked by easing the fretting hand off the strings.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="boogaloo" data-chart="F7|F7|Bb7|F7" data-tempo="112" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp bass" data-comp="guitar" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Boogaloo stabs","opts":{"compRhythm":"stabs"}}]'></div>

## Step 6: Two chords in a bar

Harder: now some bars have two chords, two beats each. The pattern keeps its rhythm and changes chord where the bar does: watch the staff for the hit that lands on beat 3.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="boogaloo" data-chart="F7|Bb7 C7|F7|Gm7 C7" data-tempo="112" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp bass" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Boogaloo stabs","opts":{"compRhythm":"stabs"}}]'></div>
